text.formatted: The pirate makes three attacks, using Rapier or Pistol in any combination.
text.plain: The pirate makes three attacks, using Rapier or Pistol in any combination.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +7, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the pirate has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the pirate has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.

text.formatted: _Ranged Attack Roll:_ +7, range 30/90 ft. _Hit:_ 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.
text.plain: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

text.formatted: _Wisdom Saving Throw:_ DC 14, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. _Failure:_ The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate's next turn.
text.plain: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate's next turn.

text.formatted: _Trigger:_ The pirate is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. _Response:_ The pirate adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. On a miss, the pirate makes one Rapier attack against the triggering creature if within range.
